message: Honestly the best shop in town, I tell everyone. Anyway, since my crash on Sunday the front wheel rubs the fork. When can I drop it off?
I was going to order a new chain, but your mechanic said last time it might just need adjusting. Can he check it before I buy anything?
Not sure if this is for you or the online team: the e-bike I bought here in March now cuts out on hills. Can someone test it?
No rush at all: the kickstand you fitted last week wobbles. Could you tighten it next time I'm in?
My daughter says her brakes "feel funny". I don't know bikes at all. Can someone have a look on Saturday?
the gears r skipping again lol, can i bring it in tmrw before work
I've ordered from you a dozen times and never complained, but the headset you installed is creaking badly. Please fix it.
Do you do house calls? My cargo bike has a flat and it's too heavy to push to the shop.
Before I give up and buy a new bike: can my 1998 steel frame be fitted with modern brakes?
Thanks for the refund on the gloves! Separate thing: my rear derailleur got bent in the car door. Can it be straightened?
Your website says tune-ups take a day. Mine has been rattling for a week, so please book me in for one.
I'm writing a review of your shop, but first I need my pedals tightened. They keep coming loose.
Is it normal for disc brakes to squeal in the rain? If not, I'd like them checked.
The trailer hitch I brought from home doesn't fit my bike. Can your workshop make it fit?
Not a complaint! I just need the saddle on my road bike lowered 2 cm and I can't do it myself.
Could you swap the tires on my bike for the winter ones? I already have them at home.
My chain came off three times on today's ride. Is that something you can sort out today?
URGENT: race on Saturday and my shifter is stuck. Can you look at it tomorrow?
My tubeless tire keeps losing air overnight. Can you find the leak?
I tried to adjust my brakes with a video and made it worse. Help?
The mechanic was great and said my tires are worn out. Can you set aside two 700x32 tires for me?
Lovely staff, lovely shop, terrible delivery: my order #6120 is a week late. Where is it?
I'd like to return the bike I collected yesterday. Nothing is wrong with it, I changed my mind.
The rear light in my order arrived broken, so please send a new one.
Your website says $49 for the pump but the till charged me $59. I'd like the difference back.
Is the gravel bike I tried on Saturday still available? My partner wants to buy it as a gift.
Sorry for the long message. I bought a helmet for my son, he hates the colour, and I'd like to swap it for the blue one.
Do you repair... sorry, I mean do you sell repair stands? I want one for my garage.
Could the chain I ordered be fitted when it arrives? Actually, forget the fitting, just ship it to me.
My mechanic friend says your brake pads are excellent. Do you have any for Shimano discs?
pls cancel the lock i ordered, found my old one
I paid for express shipping and it came by standard. Can I get the difference refunded?
Thanks again for fixing my wheel last month! Now I need a second wheel for my other bike. What's the price?
Your Sunday group ride is fun. Do you sell the club jerseys everyone wears?
The box arrived crushed and the saddle inside is torn. What happens now?
Can I put a deposit on the e-bike today and pay the rest next month?
Can the kids' bike be delivered before my son's birthday on the 14th?
I need an invoice with my company name for the bike I bought, for my taxes.
Do you still have the folding bike in the window? I'll come and buy it if it's under $600.
The chain I received is 11-speed but my order said 12-speed. Please exchange it.
I had to wait 40 minutes for a simple tune-up today. Not happy about that.
Your mechanic fixed my brakes, my gears and my mood. Best Saturday in a while.
Why is the shop closed on Sundays? Seems like a missed opportunity.
URGENT!!! The free coffee machine is the best thing you've ever done. Never remove it.
I ordered a bike online last month and the whole process was smooth from start to finish.
The repair was fine but the receipt had my name spelled wrong. Just thought you'd want to know.
It would be nice if you stocked more parts for vintage bikes, but I understand it's a small market.
Just back from a 500 km tour on the bike you built for me. Not a single problem.
Your new website looks great, but the stock numbers seem out of date.
The delivery driver was rude. The bike was fine, though.
Tell your mechanic Ana she's a legend. My old bike rides like new.
I was annoyed the helmet I wanted was out of stock, but the one I got instead is better anyway.
Your prices went up again. I'll keep coming, but it stings.
I don't need anything, I just wanted to say thank you for the kids' cycling day.
The workshop was messy when I picked up my bike. Not the end of the world.
Love that you recycle old tires. More shops should do that.
Would you ever consider a second store on the east side? The trip is long for us.
Note to self: stop buying bike gadgets. Your shop makes it too hard. Great selection!
The checkout queue was a mess on Saturday. Maybe open a second till at weekends.
Your chain cleaning tip in the newsletter saved me a trip to the shop. Thanks!
